"""Complete only unfinished V168 inference,then unchanged scoring,audit and rendering."""
import os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save,guard
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v3';plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
(root/'postprocess-controller.claim').open('x').close();prior=read(Path(plan['original_partial_review_root'])/'postprocess-status-v1.json')
status={'status':'running-review-continuation','owner':{'pid':os.getpid(),'created':psutil.Process().create_time()},'completed':{'checkpoint-validation':prior['completed']['checkpoint-validation']}}
save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status)
post=root/'postprocess-v1/scripts';env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=f"{post}:{plan['work']}/scripts:{plan['work']}/src",OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1',TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1',CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=':4096:8')
worker=read(root/'continuation-source-v1.json')['worker'];assert ref(worker['path'])==worker
sources={str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in post.glob('*.py')}
save(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json',{'root':str(root),'training_plan':ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),'design':ref(root/'quality-design-v1.json'),
 'retained_native_collections':read(root/'native-retained-comparators-v1.json')['collections'],
 'inputs':[ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),ref(root/'review-adoption-v1.json'),ref(root/'continuation-source-v1.json'),ref(root/'review-checkpoint-readiness-v1.json')],
 'frozen_files':sources,'controller':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'scope':plan['scope']})
try:
 for stage,script in [('review',worker['path']),('scores',str(post/'score_fine_mesh_trial.py')),('metric-audit',str(post/'audit_fine_mesh_trial.py')),('render',str(post/'render_fine_mesh_trial.py'))]:
  guard(plan)
  with (root/f'postprocess-{stage}-v1.log').open('x') as log:
   p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-P',script,str(root)],cwd=repo,env=env,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
   owner={'pid':p.pid,'created':psutil.Process(p.pid).create_time()};status.update(status='running-'+stage,child_owner=owner,stage=stage);save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status);code=p.wait()
  status['completed'][stage]={'owner':owner,'returncode':code};assert code==0,(stage,code)
 status['status']='completed-four-endpoint-audits-and-rendering-awaiting-actual-native-viewing';save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status)
except BaseException as error:
 status.update(status='failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry',error=repr(error));save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status);raise
print(status['status'],flush=True)
